title: 第3章 暴打天星宗第4章 拜入合欢宗
slug: 加入合欢宗后师妹的鱼塘炸了
content_zh:
第3章暴打天星宗穆荷？
云洛觉得这名字耳熟，探出头见段崖等人面色苍白。
她略微沉思，脑中灵光一闪。
穆荷，合欢宗……
她竟是传说中的惊鸿长老，不到五百岁的炼虚期大能。
金丹之后，每个大境界的实力差距犹如天堑。
换句话说，惊鸿长老要打天星宗这种小门派，比捏死一只蚂蚁还简单。
她竟遇到个金大腿！
另一边，宗主等人的脸色从愤慨转变为惊恐。
“不知是惊鸿长老大驾光临，有所怠慢，还请前辈海涵。只是不知我天星宗何处得罪了合欢宗，竟让前辈如此大动干戈？”
穆荷凌空而立，目光扫过众人，直到所有人两股战战才道∶
“谁是王毅？”
人群中，一位男子瑟缩着往后躲，但他前面的人很快往两边散开，将他暴露在穆荷面前。
“惊鸿长老……”
宗主正要问发生了何事，眼前突然一花，再回头，那叫做王毅的弟子已经倒地，瞳孔涣散，没了生机。
“惊鸿长老，你这是何意？”
没等宗主发问，无咎长老段崖已经质问起穆荷。
王毅是天星宗的内门弟子，资质不错，正好他亲传的位置空出一个。
本想等过了宗内大比将他收为弟子，结果死了。
穆荷冷哼一声，单手结印，半空中，出现一道水幕。

水幕中，一位少女被一行人逼到了绝路，王毅正是其中之一。
他们抢夺了少女手中的灵草，妄图欺辱她，逼得少女跳下魔涧。
“够清楚了吗？”
画面结束，水幕破碎，穆荷神色淡漠。
“王毅害死我合欢宗内门弟子，你说本君杀不杀得？”
合欢宗每位弟子身上都有一道特制的传讯符，哪怕是自爆也能将生前画面传回宗门。
云洛站在她身后，终于清楚一个炼虚期大能为何会出现在天星宗了。
同时，她心中生出一股艳羡。
一个普通的内门弟子，就能让宗内长老，不远万里来为弟子报仇。
如此护短的宗门，恐怕修真界仅此一家。
长老们哑然许久，段崖或许是在宗门养尊处优惯了，道∶
“即便如此，王毅是天星宗弟子，理应天星宗惩戒，惊鸿长老越俎代庖直接要了王毅性命，是不是太过了些？传出去……”
“你算是什么东西，也配质疑本君？”
穆荷凝眉，威压无形释放，段崖说到一半口吐鲜血，半跪在地上。
云洛还是第一次见段崖这么狼狈。
真是有点……爽啊。
善良的她当然要添一把火。
“惊鸿长老，他就是我那师父，段崖。”
“云洛！”
林霆一眼看到她，顿时惊呼∶“你没死？”
content_en:
Chapter 3 Beat up Tianxing Sect Mu He?
Yun Luo felt that the name sounded familiar, so he stuck his head out and saw that Duan Ya and others looked pale.
She pondered for a moment, and an idea flashed in her mind.
Mu He, Hehuan Sect...
She was actually the legendary Elder Jinghong, a powerful master in the Void Refining Stage who was less than five hundred years old.
After the Golden Elixir, the gap in strength between each realm is like a chasm.
In other words, it would be easier for Elder Jinghong to defeat a small sect like Tianxing Sect than to crush an ant to death.
She unexpectedly met a golden thigh!
On the other side, the faces of the sect leader and others changed from indignation to horror.
"I don't know if Elder Jinghong came here and was a little negligent, but I also asked my senior Haihan. I just don't know where our Tianxing Sect offended the Hehuan Sect, so that our seniors went to war like this?"
Mu He stood in the air and glanced at everyone. He didn't say until everyone was fighting with each other:
"Who is Wang Yi?"
In the crowd, a man cowered and hid, but the people in front of him quickly dispersed to both sides, exposing him to Mu He.
"Elder Jinghong..."
The sect leader was about to ask what happened when his eyes suddenly blurred. When he turned around, he saw that the disciple named Wang Yi had fallen to the ground, his pupils were dilated and lifeless.
"Elder Jinghong, what do you mean?"
Before the sect leader could ask questions, Wu Jiu elder Duan Ya had already questioned Mu He.
Wang Yi is an inner disciple of the Tianxing Sect, with good qualifications, and there happens to be a vacant position for him to teach directly.
I wanted to wait until the sect's great competition to accept him as a disciple, but he died.
Mu He snorted coldly, formed a seal with one hand, and a water curtain appeared in mid-air.
In the water curtain, a girl was cornered by a group of people, and Wang Yi was one of them.
They snatched the spiritual grass from the girl's hands, tried to humiliate her, and forced the girl to jump into the devil's stream.
"Is it clear enough?"
The scene ends, the water curtain breaks, and Mu He looks indifferent.
"Wang Yi killed my inner disciple of Hehuan Sect. Do you think I can kill him?"
Each disciple of the Hehuan Sect has a special communication talisman on his body. Even if he self-destructs, the scene of his death can be sent back to the sect.
Yun Luo stood behind her and finally understood why a great master in the Void Refining Stage appeared in Tianxing Sect.
At the same time, she felt a sense of envy in her heart.
An ordinary inner disciple can make the elders of the sect travel thousands of miles to avenge the disciple.
I'm afraid this is the only sect in the world of cultivation that protects its shortcomings in this way.
The elders were silent for a long time. Duan Ya might have been used to being pampered in the sect, so he said:
"Even so, Wang Yi is a disciple of the Tianxing Sect and deserves to be punished by the Tianxing Sect. Elder Jinghong overstepped his authority and directly took Wang Yi's life. Is it too much? Spread the word..."
"Who do you think you are, worthy of questioning me?"
Mu He frowned, and the pressure was released invisibly. Duan Ya vomited blood in the middle of speaking and knelt on the ground.
This was the first time Yunluo saw Duan Ya in such a mess.
It's really... cool.
Of course she has to add fuel to the fire.
"Elder Jinghong, he is my master, Duan Ya."
"Yunluo!"
When Lin Ting saw her, he immediately exclaimed: "Are you not dead?"
